Not built - needs a maintainer look. No blocking findings.

The change addresses #1611. The `always()` function removes the default `success()` check. The remaining conditions exclude cancelled, skipped, cut-skipped, and non-main dispatch runs. This matches the [GitHub documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/expressions#status-check-functions).

Checks performed locally:
- The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `7f2d9bfc4efe40dbf12e06c93f2675896814925b` has no conflicts.
- Python `yaml.safe_load` parses the merged workflow. A comparison with main confirms that `always()` is the only semantic YAML change.
- The new test checks the status function and preserves the gate-result and cut-skip conditions. Its file-reading pattern matches the existing concurrency test.
- The body includes `Process change: yes` and `Changelog: none`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The PR changes no safety code, goldens, or UI. Safety mutations and screenshots do not apply.

Not built: `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` needs a maintainer look first, under the review rules. I did not run Cargo builds, tests, clippy, mutations, or any GitHub runner. The author's test results are not independent review results. A real failed gate followed by a green gate remains unverified.

Requested before merge: none.

Label: `needs-maintainer`. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
